events.summary: The case reopens on October 29. Rainier Falls, April 2005. The police have closed the file: suicide. But the evidence doesn't add up and you're the only one still looking. It Was Not a Suicide launches on October 29. Thank you to everyone who played the demo, sent feedback, and helped us shape the full release. events.title: Update Notes – Thank You for Your Feedback!
events.summary: Hi detectives, Thank you all for playing It Was Not A Suicide Demo and sharing your thoughts with us. Many of the changes in this update come directly from your feedback, so please keep it coming! Improvements & FixesGraphics settings on first launch: Fixed an issue where graphics and resolution settings defaulted to the lowest options when launching the game for the first time. Notes cursor: Added a visible text cursor to the notes, so you can always see which line you're writing on. ESC to go

events.title: The It Was Not a Suicide Demo Is Out October 14!
